authorProcess: Claude Code session (Research Intelligence PHASE 2, STEP 16) — design only; no observation file opened, no selection run
onlyChangeFromStep14Rule: window selection: one earliest qualifying window per region → chronological accumulation of earliest qualifying windows (non-overlapping, ≥72 h apart) until the region cohort reaches 10 unique drifters (cap 6 windows). Everything else identical.

eligibility.E3: 73 hourly samples t0..t0+72h, consecutive gap <= 1 h, provider gap <= 3600 s
eligibility.E4: nearest Natural Earth 1:10m coastline vertex > 100 km at t0
eligibility.E5: t0 position inside region box; leaving later is not an exclusion

A1.definition: median over eligible of first-observed-displacement / elapsed seconds

A3.definition: median min-angle(bearing t0→t24, bearing t24→t72); leg < 1 km → 180

windowQualification: eligible >= 8 AND A1 AND A2 AND A3

accumulation.drifterUniqueness: an ID already in the region cohort is not added again (counts toward window qualification only)
accumulation.rationale: 해역당 최대 6개 window에서 최소 10개의 고유 drifter를 확보하고, 최종적으로 10기 이상을 확보한 해역 중 cohort size가 큰 상위 2개 해역을 선택한다. 최종 총 cohort가 20기 이상이면 PASS이며, 그렇지 않으면 BLOCKED이다.
accumulation.overlapStatement: 채택 window 간 직접적인 시간 중첩을 금지하여 temporal overlap을 제거한다. 이후 forcing/model 단계에서 run 간 통계적 독립성은 별도로 검토한다.

regionSelectionOrder: region cohort size after accumulation, descending
tieBreak: alphabetical region ID; window order has no ties
duplicatePolicy: identical (ID,time) rows collapsed; conflicting rows exclude the drifter (duplicateConflict)
missingData: never zero-filled; missing/gap → E3 exclusion for that window; empty quarter files recorded
determinism: two runs on identical inputs must give identical selectionHash, cohort (minus createdAtUTC) and audit; selectionHash excludes timestamps
forbiddenInputs: STEP 15 per-window counts or dates as selection inputs
postHocGuard: The only rule change is single-window → chronological accumulation. No criterion targets window size, speed, displacement, a date, a year, a region or a drifter. The designer acknowledges that the committed STEP 15 audit shows qualifying windows exist in all four regions; the rule does not consult that audit and starts from the earliest window regardless of size.
stopCondition: fewer than 2 regions reaching 10 unique drifters, or total < 20 → COHORT_SELECTION_BLOCKED; the rule is not modified afterwards
lockPolicy: LOCK 이후 rule 내용 수정 금지; 변경은 새 ruleId 로만
